name: parqueadero-monorepo
description: Delegación de scripts npm hacia frontend/ (Ionic + Capacitor).

scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix microservices && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --prefix microservices && npm run lint:fix --prefix frontend
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix microservices && npm run format --prefix frontend
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --prefix microservices && npm run format:check --prefix frontend
